explanation: Requested a 5-point cos(theta*) scan from -1 to +1 (i.e. -1, -0.5, 0, 0.5, 1) at W=1.7 GeV, Q2=1.5 GeV^2, phi*=90 deg. Preflight check flagged the two endpoint values, cos(theta*) = -1.0 and +1.0, as FAIL: EXCLURAD cannot evaluate exactly at the forward/backward poles (singular kinematics). Per the tool's documented validated convention, these were clamped to +/-0.999 instead of being dropped, preserving the intended 5-point scan while avoiding the singularity. The other three points (-0.5, 0, 0.5) passed all checks unchanged. Re-running preflight on the corrected point set returned a full PASS, and the input file was generated successfully.
